title: An X-Pastor Answers A Very Important Question

top_liked.author: @TonyAMO
top_liked.text:
It's always so hard to keep your faith when you're constantly thinking about others instead of just yourself.
I just wish more theists understood that.

top_liked.author: @toneg3768
top_liked.text: I thought Jesus said you only need faith the size of a mustard seed. Glad you found your way out. 👊🏼✌🏼

top_liked.author: @gir2195
top_liked.text: Ironically, I said "amen" to this. Programming runs deep.

top_liked.author: @Childfree334
top_liked.text: This God won't even respond to protect the babies and children it's supposed to value so much, but it sure does protect the people that hurt them.

top_liked.author: @thehigherevolutionary
top_liked.text: It always seems like God works at the rate of chance. If your life going to work out to mere happenstances what's the point? Some everafter on a cloud? No thanks.
